notes: The fixture uses one Shape-C item transfer, two balance deltas, and one ownership transition per receipt.
The Parquet byte count is measured from encode_receipt_object; the ownership entry size is size_of::<OwnershipEvent>() in this build.
The external merge sort retains one 4,096-event run plus 16 run heads, so its ownership-event working set is 4,112 * 56 = 230,272 bytes, independent of transitions retained.

audit::conservation::tests::thirty_day_synthetic_archive_stays_inside_ownership_memory_ceiling exercises 30 page-sized archive objects through the multi-stage merge and asserts the stated 256 KiB ceiling.

identity.reason: ReceiptBalanceDelta and ReceiptOwnershipTransition carry AccountId directly.

layout_verdict.daily_24h_window: the ownership re-sort is bounded at 224.875 KiB (230,272 bytes), below the 256 KiB stated ceiling; scan volume remains a separate capacity concern
layout_verdict.full_30d_retention: the sweep still reads about 100.67 GiB per full pass, but the ownership re-sort remains 224.875 KiB rather than growing to 71.65 GiB
layout_verdict.chosen_shape: #890 uses a bounded external merge sort over the captured receipt objects. It preserves full-window findings without a new tailer-side archive object or a carried item cursor.
